title: Proposition A
subtitle: Harris County Emergency Services District No. 20 — 20-Year Renewal
summary: Proposition A asks voters to approve a 20-year renewal of the existing emergency services district that provides fire and emergency medical services to the City of Jersey Village.
details: This is a renewal of the existing district, not a new tax.
The district currently provides fire protection and emergency medical services to Jersey Village residents.
Approval continues current fire and EMS service levels for an additional 20 years.
forArguments: Maintains current fire and emergency response capabilities without interruption.
No increase in the existing tax rate — this renews the current arrangement.
Ensures continued professional fire and EMS coverage for the community.
againstArguments: Commits the city to a 20-year term with limited ability to renegotiate.
Some residents prefer shorter renewal periods for more frequent public review.
Long-term commitments reduce flexibility to explore alternative service models.
